description: This file defines the TalkOverlayController class, a SwiftUI-based controller managing the presentation, dismissal, and state of a talk overlay panel in a macOS application. It includes properties for UI layout, methods to present and dismiss the overlay, and update functions for overlay state such as phase, pause, and level. It also contains private helper methods for window management.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A SwiftUI-based controller for managing a talk overlay panel, including presentation, dismissal, and state updates.

classes.name: TalkOverlayHostingView
classes.description: A custom NSHostingView subclass that allows the overlay to accept first mouse events.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and displays the overlay window with the TalkOverlayView.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay window with animation.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of the talk overlay, logging the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates whether the overlay is paused, with logging.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the level indicator of the overlay within the range 0 to 1.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the window's origin to a specified CGPoint.
